info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Standing Orders Management API
info.description: The Standing Orders Management API facilitates the creation and management of standing orders for bank accounts. This endpoint allows users to define recurring payment instructions associated with their accounts, ensuring timely and automated financial transactions. Typical consumers of this API include banking applications and financial service providers who want to enhance their offerings with automated payment solutions. By utilizing this API, developers can streamline customer payments and improve cash flow management for users.

post.summary: Create a new standing order for a specific account.
post.description: This operation allows you to set up a standing order for the account identified by ACC-200045. A standing order is an instruction to a bank to pay a set amount at regular intervals to another account, making it easier to manage recurring payments.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new standing order for the specified account. The request must include all required fields to successfully establish the standing order.
